name: Chic strut square bass
desc: Sibling flavor: syncopated square-wave strut over F-Bb-Gm-C (I-IV-ii-V) with rests and octave answers — more Rodgers/Edwards bounce than pump. Half-bar gain duck, 12db filter, octave ghost-pops via off-canon. Peak doubles into 16th runs every 4th cycle.

code.full: note("<[f1 ~ [f1 f2] ~ f1 ~ f2 ~] [bb1 ~ [bb1 bb2] ~ bb1 ~ bb2 ~] [g1 ~ [g1 g2] ~ g1 ~ g2 ~] [c2 ~ [c2 c3] ~ c2 ~ [c2 bb1] ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("square").ftype('12db').lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}*1.4).slow(16)).lpq(5).attack(.004).decay(.16).sustain(.18).release(.06).shape(.2).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.55, ${gain}).fast(2)).room(.12).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.28).decay(.1).sustain(0)).fast(${rate}).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[f1 f1 [~ f1] f2 ~ f1 f2 [f2 f3]] [bb1 bb1 [~ bb1] bb2 ~ bb1 bb2 [bb2 bb3]] [g1 g1 [~ g1] g2 ~ g1 g2 [g2 g3]] [c2 c2 [~ c2] c3 ~ c2 c3 [c3 g2]]>").add(note(${root})).s("square").ftype('12db').lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.7).slow(8)).lpq(6).attack(.003).decay(.15).sustain(.15).release(.05).shape(.25).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.5, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(.12).every(4, x=>x.fast(2)).fast(${rate}).orbit(3).play()
